explanation: Implemented all ten B06 diagram edits using the pinned source and accepted canvas state. Agent Chat has 42 concept lines; the push-enabled DiffSession workflow has 36. Updates preserve existing responsibilities while introducing selective reads, read-scoped aliases, exact checkpoint publication, highlights and synchronized chat references. Chat editing still invokes generation, and exec mutations still commit individually. These boundaries support later extensions without portraying them as implemented. All trees fit their scaffold bounds; positions are null and the six edges retain their specified order.
